name: Craft Magic Arms and Armor
description: Create magic weapons, armor, and shields.

name: Craft Rod
description: Create magic rods.

name: Craft Staff
description: Create magic staves.

name: Craft Wand
description: Create magic wands.

name: Craft Wondrous Item
description: Create wondrous items.

name: Forge Ring
description: Create magic rings.

name: Enlarge Spell
description: Double the range of a close, medium, or long range spell. Uses a slot one level higher.

name: Extend Spell
description: Double a spell's duration. Uses a slot one level higher.

name: Heighten Spell
description: Cast a spell as if it were a higher level, up to 9th. Uses a slot of that higher level.

name: Maximize Spell
description: Maximize all variable numeric effects of a spell. Uses a slot three levels higher.

name: Quicken Spell
description: Cast a spell as a swift action. Uses a slot four levels higher.

name: Silent Spell
description: Cast a spell without verbal components. Uses a slot one level higher.

name: Still Spell
description: Cast a spell without somatic components. Uses a slot one level higher.

name: Widen Spell
description: Double the area of a burst, emanation, or spread spell. Uses a slot three levels higher.

name: Animal Affinity
description: Bonus on Handle Animal and Ride checks, larger at 10 ranks in the skill.

name: Athletic
description: Bonus on Climb and Swim checks, larger at 10 ranks in the skill.

name: Deceitful
description: Bonus on Bluff and Disguise checks, larger at 10 ranks in the skill.

name: Deft Hands
description: Bonus on Disable Device and Sleight of Hand checks, larger at 10 ranks in the skill.

name: Self-Sufficient
description: Bonus on Heal and Survival checks, larger at 10 ranks in the skill.

name: Stealthy
description: Bonus on Escape Artist and Stealth checks, larger at 10 ranks in the skill.

name: Improved Great Fortitude
description: Once per day, reroll a Fortitude save and keep the second result.

name: Improved Lightning Reflexes
description: Once per day, reroll a Reflex save and keep the second result.

name: Endurance
description: +4 on checks and saves to resist exhaustion, hunger, thirst, suffocation, and exposure. Sleep in light or medium armor without fatigue.

name: Diehard
description: Stabilize automatically below 0 hp and choose to stay conscious, staggered.

name: Fleet
description: +5 feet of base speed in light or no armor and under a light load. Stacks if taken again.

name: Run
description: Run at five times your speed (four in heavy armor or under a heavy load) and keep your Dex bonus to AC.

name: Nimble Moves
description: Ignore 5 feet of difficult terrain when you move.

name: Acrobatic Steps
description: Ignore another 15 feet of difficult terrain when you move (20 total with Nimble Moves).

name: Improved Counterspell
description: Counterspell with a spell of the same school that is a higher spell level.

name: Augment Summoning
description: Creatures you summon gain a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength and Constitution.

name: Greater Spell Penetration
description: Another +2 bonus on caster level checks to overcome spell resistance.

name: Master Craftsman
subject: Skill
description: Choose a Craft or Profession skill with 5 or more ranks. +2 bonus on it, and its ranks can count as caster level for certain item creation feats. (The 5-ranks rule for the chosen skill isn't checked yet.)

name: Natural Spell
description: Cast spells while in wild shape.

name: Alignment Channel
subject: AlignmentSubtype
description: Choose chaos, evil, good, or law. Channel energy can heal or harm outsiders of that subtype.

name: Elemental Channel
subject: ElementalSubtype
description: Choose an elemental subtype. Channel energy can heal or harm outsiders of that subtype.

name: Extra Channel
description: Channel energy two additional times per day.

name: Extra Ki
description: Your ki pool increases by 2. Stacks if taken again.

name: Extra Lay On Hands
description: Use lay on hands two additional times per day. Stacks if taken again.

name: Extra Mercy
subject: Mercy
description: Your lay on hands gains one additional mercy for which you qualify.

name: Extra Performance
description: Use bardic performance for 6 additional rounds per day. Stacks if taken again.

name: Extra Rage
description: Rage for 6 additional rounds per day. Stacks if taken again.

name: Selective Channeling
description: Choose targets, up to your Charisma modifier, that your channeled energy does not affect.

name: Command Undead
description: Spend a channel negative energy use to take control of undead within 30 feet.

name: Turn Undead
description: Spend a channel positive energy use to make undead within 30 feet flee.
